Elena (CEO): Afternoon all 10 Quick leadership huddle note: three strategic asks for the next sprint window. 1) ship a safe, measured private beta (no surprises for customers); 2) drive down unit cost by two levers (caching + shorter seq budgets) and show projected Q impact; 3) tighten rollback/observability for any model or infra rollouts. More below.

Maya (VP Product): Context: private beta list locked at 20 customers. We want a reliable first impression 10. Product will gate on privacy signoffs, support SLA, and two hallucination evals.

Nina (Head Privacy): EU/UK privacy checklist: final review done, only item left is contract attachment for data residency. Legal is on it, ETA Thu EOD. No blockers to beta if contract is signed.

Alex (VP Sales): Sales update: 3 inbound enterprise pilots pre-approved for private deployment. If beta timeline shifts, Ill notify buyers and offer a soft start. Revenue ops: pref you avoid surprises in pricing changes during beta.

Raj (VP Eng): Canary plan for next rollout: staging -> 5% -> 25% -> 60%. Must pass the canary probe for 48m at each stage. We'll hold on any >25% traffic increase until SRE signoff.

Sam (Head SRE): Recent incident note: automated scaler miscalculated instance health and triggered extra scale-downs during a load spike; caused ~8m of degraded throughput for some routes. Postmortem in progress. Immediate mitigation: temporary scaling threshold raised and a healthcheck debounce added.

incident-bot: Incident #2026-03-12-42 created: scaler-debounce-failure. Severity: S2. Link: https://incidents.internal/2026-03-12-42

Sam (Head SRE): Live metrics snapshot (last 24h):
- uptime: 99.994% (goal 99.995%)
- mean p95 gen latency: 158ms
- tail 99.9: 2.1s (improved after GC tuning)
- error rate: 0.12% (baseline 0.1%)
- committed dedicated capacity: 12 nodes (3 active pilot clusters)

Tess (Head Finance): Finance numbers: current blended infra cost per 1M tokens = $142. Target for end of quarter = $120. Short plan: 1) prioritize hot-cache policies for high-volume customers; 2) run workload quantization POC on non-critical models; 3) tighter sequence defaults for chat SDKs. Will circulate a one-pager Tue morning.

Maya (VP Product): Product asks / gating checklist for beta go/no-go:
- privacy contract signed (Nina)
- support rota and runbook ready (Grace + Support)
- 2 hallucination evals completed (QA)
- rollback playbook and tracing hooks validated (SRE/Eng)

Raj (VP Eng): Engineering commitments this week:
- finish router circuit-breaker implementation (ETA: Wed noon)
- land autoscale debounce + test (ETA: today 18:00 UTC)
- provide a canary dashboard for execs (ETA: tomorrow standup)

Elena (CEO): Two executive asks: 1) by Wed 09:00 PT, each lead posts one-line owner + current blocker in #release-war-room; 2) by Fri EOD, Tech + Finance to submit 3 discrete cost actions with estimated delta to $/1M tokens.

Tess (Head Finance): Acknowledged. I'll post the cost actions doc after the Finance-Eng sync Wed 11:00 PT.

Alex (VP Sales): I'll hold buyer comms until we confirm the beta schedule. If we shift by >5 days, I'll offer staggered onboarding.

Maya (VP Product): Suggestion: freeze non-critical feature merges to master until the beta has passed 2 weeks without major rollbacks. Opinions?

Raj (VP Eng): Agree with a short freeze window for non-blocking features. We'll label merges accordingly.

Elena (CEO): Approve the freeze. Prioritize stability. If a merge is critical, tag with #expedite and get a cross-team signoff.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy to prod-dedicated at 2026-03-14T07:00:00Z (stage 5% -> 25%). See dashboard: https://deploys.internal/2170052468

Sam (Head SRE): I'll run a focused chaos experiment Thursday evening on a single dedicated cluster to validate fallback behavior. Results will be posted in #incidents.

Maya (VP Product): Will update the beta invite copy to set expectations for measured rollout and possible delays.

Elena (CEO): Thanks team. High-level note: customers care most about reliability in this phase. Tight feedback loops > new features. Short daily updates in this thread ok. :rocket:
